description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated retail chain with 198 locations across British Columbia, making this Campbell River outlet one of the most reliably stocked spots on Vancouver Island for wine, spirits, beer, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages. The store accepts empty container returns for deposit refunds, a practical perk for cyclists who have been carrying empties. As a BCLIQUOR Signature-format store, it offers an expanded selection and on-site product consultants.
